info.title: dispatch-witness — records what a SoEx component graph actually did during a no-mock test run.
info.description: Records what a SoEx component graph actually did during a no-mock test run, keyed to the MethodSketch design it is evidence for.

options.name: --submit
options.description:
iteration that issued its design, and refuses a design the sketch never issued.
It first asks for the last run on the same branch (any branch for a branch's
first run) and sends only the states and methods that run did not have; the
rest go by name. The file on disk keeps everything. The sketch is --sketch-id, or the one the run was recorded with; add
--organisation for a sketch that belongs to one. The token is read from
DISPATCH_WITNESS_TOKEN, never the command line — a machine token from your
MethodSketch account page. A refused submit exits non-zero and leaves the file.
